query: Compare the major frontend state management libraries (Redux, MobX, Zustand, Recoil) in a feature table.
narrative:
Here's a comparative analysis of four major frontend state management libraries: Redux, MobX, Zustand, and Recoil.

| Feature                 | Redux                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | MobX                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Zustand                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Recoil                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|-------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Architecture**        | Centralized store with immutable state and unidirectional data flow. ([selleo.com](https://selleo.com/blog/what-is-redux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Observable state with automatic tracking and reactions. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Minimalistic, hook-based API without the need for context providers. ([zustand.docs.pmnd.rs](https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs/learn/getting-started/comparison?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Atom-based state management with selectors for derived state. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   |
| **Learning Curve**      | Steep due to concepts like actions, reducers, and middleware. ([npm-compare.com](https://npm-compare.com/mobx%2Crecoil%2Credux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Moderate; intuitive API but requires understanding observables and reactions. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Gentle; simple API with minimal boilerplate. ([zustand.docs.pmnd.rs](https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs/learn/getting-started/comparison?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Moderate; aligns closely with React paradigms but introduces atoms and selectors. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   |
| **Boilerplate**         | High; requires actions, reducers, and often middleware. ([npm-compare.com](https://npm-compare.com/mobx%2Crecoil%2Credux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Low; minimal setup with automatic reactivity. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Very low; concise API with minimal setup. ([zustand.docs.pmnd.rs](https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs/learn/getting-started/comparison?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Low; minimal setup with built-in async support. ([npm-compare.com](https://npm-compare.com/mobx%2Crecoil%2Credux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   |
| **Performance**         | Good; efficient with proper memoization using reselect. ([index.dev](https://www.index.dev/skill-vs-skill/redux-vs-mobx-vs-zustand?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Excellent; fine-grained updates with automatic dependency tracking. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Excellent; minimal re-render overhead due to selector-based subscriptions. ([index.dev](https://www.index.dev/skill-vs-skill/redux-vs-mobx-vs-zustand?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Excellent; per-atom subscriptions allow for fine-grained updates. ([npm-compare.com](https://npm-compare.com/mobx%2Crecoil%2Credux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   |
| **Bundle Size**         | ~12-15KB minified + gzipped (Redux core), ~40-50KB with Redux Toolkit. ([index.dev](https://www.index.dev/skill-vs-skill/redux-vs-mobx-vs-zustand?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | 16.5 KB minified, 6 KB gzipped. ([index.dev](https://www.index.dev/skill-vs-skill/redux-vs-mobx-vs-zustand?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | 1.2 KB minified + gzipped. ([index.dev](https://www.index.dev/skill-vs-skill/redux-vs-mobx-vs-zustand?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | 29.5 KB gzipped. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/recoil-vs-redux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   |
| **Async Support**       | Requires middleware like Redux Thunk or Redux Saga. ([npm-compare.com](https://npm-compare.com/mobx%2Crecoil%2Credux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Built-in support for async actions. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Supports async actions natively. ([zustand.docs.pmnd.rs](https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs/learn/getting-started/comparison?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Built-in support for async selectors. ([npm-compare.com](https://npm-compare.com/mobx%2Crecoil%2Credux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   |
| **Community & Ecosystem** | Mature ecosystem with extensive community support and middleware options. ([selleo.com](https://selleo.com/blog/what-is-redux?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Mature ecosystem with extensive community support and integrations. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Growing community with increasing adoption. ([zustand.docs.pmnd.rs](https://zustand.docs.pmnd.rs/learn/getting-started/comparison?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   | Growing community; React-specific with close alignment to React's development. ([devpick.co](https://devpick.co/mobx-vs-recoil?utm_source=openai))                                                                                   |

**Confidence Level:** High. The information is sourced from recent and reputable articles, providing a comprehensive comparison of these state management libraries.
